messages:
maria: Hey team, started seeing a p99 spike + a few inference 5xxs from eastus-inference pool around 11:02 UTC. Anyone digging into east-west network between hosts?
infra-bot: Alert: inference-service.p99 > 3000ms (eastus-inference), 11:05 UTC. Related hosts: host-02, host-07, host-09.
alex: I'm on it — looking at host metrics now. packet_loss counters bumped on host-02 -> host-07 path.
sam: Ran quick check on host-02. `tc -s qdisc show dev eth0` shows a `tbf` root qdisc with lots of dropped packets. Strange, we usually expect `fq_codel` or no shaping on these hosts.
sam: ```
qdisc tbf 1: root refcnt 2 rate 50Mbit burst 32Kb latency 400ms
 Sent 123456789 bytes  pkt 98765 drop 12345
 backlog 0b 0p requeues 0
```
erin: Ugh — we pushed a net-qos change into the image last night to enforce per-tenant egress caps. Looks like the change applied `tbf` as a root qdisc on some AMI variants by mistake. It was intended for the edge NAT hosts only.
alex: That matches: tbf introduces queuing + drops at higher egress, which explains p99 token latency for inference (east-west RPCs got requeued/dropped).
josh: Suggest immediate rollback on affected hosts. Running: `ansible-playbook rollback-qos.yml -l eastus-inference --limit host-02,host-07,host-09` to remove the tbf and restore `fq_codel`.
josh: Command we push: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root fq_codel limit 10000 noecn` — should clear drops and improve latency without sudden bursts.
infra-bot: Runbook step executed by josh at 11:18 UTC: QoS rollback applied to host-02 & host-07; host-09 still pending (OOM on agent causing delay).
ops-runbooks: Updated runbook: add post-deploy verify `tc -s qdisc` + check `tc -s qdisc | grep drop` to alert; added gating so net-qos image is only used for NAT hosts.
maria: After rollback p99 dropped from ~3s -> ~150ms within 2 minutes. Still watching for any residual errors. :tada:
sam: We should also add a node-provisioning check: detect unexpected root qdisc type during image validation (CI test). I'll open a PR to the provisioning repo.
erin: Agreed. Also adding a preflight that checks `ip link mtu` vs expected — we saw some MTU mismatches in other clusters make fq_codel behave oddly.
alex: Filed infra ticket INFRA-1278 to block net-qos image from default rollout until can scope by role. Assigned to me + erin.
josh: Quick note: for RDMA nodes we must never install TBF as root qdisc — it breaks verbs. Adding a sticky comment in the image build.
infra-bot: Created alert: `node.qdisc.drops > 0` -> pager if sustained > 30s for production inference pools.
maria: Thx all — great quick turnaround. Let's do a short blameless postmortem and add the test to image CI.
sam: I'll draft the PM and include exact `tc -s` output and ansible playbook id.
